request.question: Adopt atomic_start_version 1 in pose-dist?
request.context: Shadow: adoption adds 39 start-reconciliation obligations restricting closeout of every spec already in progress, and no command records a baseline for them or applies an adoption cutoff. Report .pose/reports/pose-abm-capability-adoption.md.

options.consequence: Keep it unadopted until a legacy baseline command or an adoption cutoff exists (follow-up recorded).
Set atomic_start_version 1 now and accept 39 blocked closeouts until each spec is reconciled by hand.

reason: Answered by the maintainer in the Claude Code session on 2026-10-05 (session_01JwmEqaPc2ybs8EpEfBTa5k): option B — first add an adoption cutoff (atomic_start_adopted_at) so specs already in progress are reported, not blocked; then adopt atomic_start_version 1 with today's date.
